policy: 513 selected open clusters. These plots show the accepted population, not the excluded parent catalogue.
Mandatory lists: messier, caldwell, sac_urban, rasc_finest_ngc, sac_best_ngc
All resolved cluster rows and unresolved claims retained; mandatory rows bypass all numeric cuts.
Intersection: positive source radius/member_count, finite Hunt V10, strict V10 below sloping boundary and max_v10; source-specific reddening cut.
Numeric limits: V10 < 12.5; E(B-V) limit: 3.0; available-source policy: all.
Depuration: retain Hunt type o and Dias-only open clusters. Single-source objects need other compilation or observing-list evidence; masked claims remain for review.

Hunt V10 is the tenth brightest accepted member, not integrated cluster magnitude. Identifier-matched Dias points share Hunt V10; no independent Dias V10 is supplied. Filled symbols use Dias data, hollow symbols Hunt data.
Strict separation < both published radii; reciprocal unique unmatched pairs are provisional and retain unresolved alias review flags.
